reason: Batch 003 source audit removed unsupported penalty ranges, restitution amounts, dollar values, and scenario statistics; questions now use RA 9266 IRR and UAP Code of Ethics conduct categories.

proposed.text: An architect receives a supplier commission or discount connected to a product recommendation. What does the UAP Code of Ethics require?

options.text: The commission is always allowed if disclosed
The architect may keep any market discount personally
Commissions, discounts, fees, gifts, or favors that create reciprocal obligation are prohibited; market discounts are credited to the client
This is governed only by RA 9184

proposed.rationale: UAP Code of Ethics provision 4-b prohibits such benefits when they create reciprocal obligation and says market discounts belong to the client.
proposed.explanation: The edit removes the unsupported 12 percent scenario while preserving the tested ethics rule.
